infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the laboratory security arsenal (R23) in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs keycard (Red) (Red) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A United Security-issued TerraGroup Labs keycard for support staff.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- The door opened by this keycard will automatically lock itself upon closure and can be opened both from the inside and outside.
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- On Cultists
- On The Goons
- In Rare valuables crates

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"
- At the "giving tree" behind the "Old Gas Station"

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text:
- On Glukhar
- In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- On Kaban
- In the "marked room" at the abandoned factory
- In the "marked room" at Chekannaya 13

sections.heading: Lighthouse
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- In Leons's hideout on the second floor of a house in the village, tucked in the printer

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- East wing room 206 (can also be accessed via East wing room 205) in the resort: On the floor between the nightstand and the bed.

- East wing room 221 (through 218) in the resort on the table with the laptop

Location in East 221

- East wing room 316 in the resort: On the floor between the nightstand and the bed.

- West wing in the resort: In the basement gym in a locker

The locker

Location in the locker

- West wing room 218 in the resort: On top of a water barrel (can also be accessed through West wing room 221 and West wing room 222)

- West wing room 203 (can also be accessed via West wing room 205) in the resort: On the floor in front of the nightstand beside the bed.

- In the resort: Administration building - next to the Health resort management office with locked safe, on the table under the ashtray

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- In Kruglov's office (R22) and the safe inside of it
- In the quarantine zone room (G11), on the desk with the desk lamp. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue) is required for entry.

- In the parking garage alarm system control room, on a desk. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow) is required for entry.

- On the bench opposite the vending machines in the cafeteria (R24) on the second level.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Laboratory security arsenal (R23) on the second level in The Lab.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- Multiple Ammunition spawns
- Multiple Weapon mods spawns
- Multiple MP5 and modded M4A1 spawns on the rack, as well as a M4A1 SOPMOD II spawn on the table
- Possible Antique teapot or Antique vase on the ground behind the desk
- Possible Intelligence folder on the desk
- TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key lock location
